page.title: Campaigns
page.description: Email sequences sent from your own mailbox. Replies and bounces stop the sequence on their own.
page.empty: No campaign yet. Create one, write the steps, import your prospects, then start it.
page.noMailboxHint: Connect a mailbox to create a campaign.

new.title: New campaign
new.description: You will write the steps and import the prospects on the next screen.
new.name: Name

errors.invalid: Give the campaign a name of 120 characters at most.

banner.noMailbox: Connect a mailbox to send campaigns.
banner.planBlocked: Your campaigns are paused: connecting a mailbox and sending campaigns takes Solo or Team.

errors.AUTH_REVOKED: The server refused the credentials. Reconnect the mailbox with a valid password.
errors.QUOTA: The provider's sending quota is reached.
errors.TRANSIENT: The mail servers cannot be reached right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.CONFIG: The mailbox configuration is invalid. Check the servers and ports.
errors.POLICY: Too many bounces: sending was paused to protect your reputation.

issues.not_found: This campaign can't be started from its current state.
issues.mailbox_not_active: The mailbox is not connected. Reconnect it in settings.
issues.document_required: Choose the document the Clozer link opens.
issues.no_enrollment: Import at least one prospect before starting.
issues.unknown_variables: No imported column fills {variables}. Add a fallback in the step, or import the column.

actions.invalidSettings: Check the name and the language.
actions.settingsRefused: These settings were refused. Check that the mailbox and the document are still available.
actions.stepResent: Step re-opened: it goes out at the next send.
actions.enrollmentUnchanged: Nothing changed: this prospect is no longer in that state.
actions.noLink: This prospect has no link yet.

header.archiveDescription: Emails not sent yet are cancelled and every prospect still in the sequence is stopped. This can't be undone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Name
settings.mailboxInactive: {email} is no longer connected. Choose another mailbox or reconnect it in settings.
settings.mailboxNone: This campaign has no mailbox. Choose one to be able to start it.
settings.documentNote: The Clozer link is only created when the step that contains it is sent.
settings.documentRequired: A document is required: a step carries the link, or the link goes out with your reply.
settings.linkOnReply: Send the link with my reply
settings.linkOnReplyHint: When a prospect answers, the link is created and added to the reply you write.
settings.documentLost: The document of this campaign is no longer available. Choose another one; saving clears it.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: Each step leaves from your mailbox a few days after the previous one. A reply or a bounce stops the sequence.
steps.subject: Subject
steps.sameThread: Sent in the same conversation, with the subject of step 1.
steps.carriesLink: This email contains the Clozer link
steps.carriesLinkTaken: Another step already carries the link.
steps.variablesHint: Fallback value: {example}. Other columns of your CSV also work.
steps.trackingHint: This passage hints that reading is tracked. Rephrase it.
steps.unknown: Unknown variable: {names}. A prospect without this value is excluded from the sequence unless you give a fallback.
steps.saveFirst: Save the steps to send a test.

test.sent: Test sent to {email}. It counts in today's sending limit of the mailbox.
test.cap: Today's sending limit of the mailbox is reached.

issues.summary: The steps can't be saved yet.
issues.delay: Step {order}: the delay must be between 1 and 60 days.
issues.several_link_steps: Only one step can carry the Clozer link.
issues.link_outside_link_step: Step {order} uses the link variable but does not carry the link.

import.title: Import prospects
import.columns: Recognized columns: {columns}. Country or timezone are optional; the other columns become variables.
import.personal: Personal addresses are accepted but flagged.

errors.tooBig: This file is too big (900 KB at most).
errors.empty: No rows found. The first line must hold the column names.
errors.failed: The import failed. The file may be too big or the connection dropped; try again.

result.title: Import result
result.tooMany: More than {max, number} rows: nothing was imported. Split the file.
result.enrolled: {count, plural, one {# prospect enrolled} other {# prospects enrolled}}
result.duplicates: {count} already in this campaign or repeated
result.team: {count, plural, one {# address of your team skipped} other {# addresses of your team skipped}}
result.personal: {count, plural, one {# personal address} other {# personal addresses}}
result.missingVariables: {count, plural, one {# prospect lacks a variable used without fallback: they will be paused at sending} other {# prospects lack a variable used without fallback: they will be paused at sending}}
result.rejected: {count, plural, one {# row rejected} other {# rows rejected}}

enrollments.title: Prospects
enrollments.empty: Nobody is enrolled yet. Import a CSV to get started.
enrollments.removeDescription: {email} will receive nothing more from this campaign.

reasons.interrupted: send interrupted: check your Sent folder

enrollments.resumeInterrupted: The last email to {email} was interrupted: it may have left already. Check your Sent folder before resuming, otherwise the prospect could receive it twice.
enrollments.resendDescription: The step may have left already for {email}. Check your Sent folder first, otherwise the prospect could receive it twice.

detail.readOnly: A teammate created this campaign: you can read it but not change it.

forwarded.description: People your prospects forwarded the document to. Nothing is sent to them until you add them.
forwarded.duplicate: This contact is already in the campaign.
forwarded.suppressed: This contact is on the stop list.
forwarded.campaign_closed: This campaign is over: start a new one to reach this contact.
